extracted.intended_audience: Authors, contributors, and journal editors involved in submitting or handling manuscripts for medical journals
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and procedural requirements for completing and submitting the ICMJE Disclosure of Interest form and for transparent disclosure of financial and non-financial relationships and activities that could constitute conflicts of interest during all stages of research and publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure of Financial and Non-Financial Relationships and Activities, and Conflicts of Interest
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclosure of Financial and Non-Financial Relationships and Activities, and Conflicts of Interest
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implied requirement that authors and contributors disclose financial and non-financial relationships and activities that could pose conflicts of interest. The navigation and page context point to ICMJE Recommendations addressing these disclosures (see II.B).

rubrics_metrics.name: Author Responsibilities — transparency of conflicts
rubrics_metrics.description: Public trust in the scientific process and the credibility of published articles depend in part on how transparently conflicts of interest are handled during the planning, implementation, writing, peer review, editing, and publication of scientific work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors are responsible for transparent handling and disclosure of conflicts across all stages (planning, implementation, writing, peer review, editing, publication). This statement frames the evaluative standard: lack of transparency undermines public trust and credibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of the ICMJE Disclosure Form (procedural requirement)
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclosure of Interest (Updated February 2021) — completed form is NOT to be submitted to the ICMJE and it cannot be saved to the ICMJE website.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical instruction: save the completed form on your own computer and check with the journal you are submitting to for specific instructions on how to submit your completed form to them. The ICMJE provides the form as a template; journals may have their own submission procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Defining the Role of Authors and Contributors
rubrics_metrics.description: Defining the Role of Authors and Contributors (navigation heading within ICMJE Recommendations).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This heading signals a standard requiring clear definition and disclosure of each person's role/contribution to the work (authorship and contributorship criteria), which affects responsibility for disclosures and accountability in peer review and publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Responsibilities in the Submission and Peer-Review Process
rubrics_metrics.description: Responsibilities in the Submission and Peer-Review Process (navigation heading within ICMJE Recommendations).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates standards governing what authors and reviewers must disclose and how conflicts should be managed during submission and peer review (e.g., recusal for conflicted reviewers, full disclosure by authors at submission). Specific procedural details are referenced by the Recommendations sections.
